audit_logs_actor_check.name: audit_logs_actor_check
audit_logs_actor_check.value: ("audit_logs"."actor_kind" = 'user' and "audit_logs"."actor_user_id" is not null and "audit_logs"."actor_membership_id" is not null) or ("audit_logs"."actor_kind" = 'system' and "audit_logs"."actor_user_id" is null and "audit_logs"."actor_membership_id" is null)

crawl_frontier_url_length_check.name: crawl_frontier_url_length_check

crawl_frontier_origin_host_check.name: crawl_frontier_origin_host_check
crawl_frontier_origin_host_check.value: length("crawl_frontier"."origin") between 8 and 4096 and length("crawl_frontier"."hostname") between 1 and 253

crawl_frontier_error_length_check.name: crawl_frontier_error_length_check
crawl_frontier_error_length_check.value: ("crawl_frontier"."error_type" is null or length("crawl_frontier"."error_type") between 1 and 120) and ("crawl_frontier"."error_message" is null or length("crawl_frontier"."error_message") between 1 and 2000)

crawl_pages_url_length_check.name: crawl_pages_url_length_check
crawl_pages_url_length_check.value: length("crawl_pages"."requested_url") between 8 and 4096 and length("crawl_pages"."normalized_url") between 8 and 4096 and ("crawl_pages"."final_url" is null or length("crawl_pages"."final_url") between 8 and 4096)

crawl_pages_error_length_check.name: crawl_pages_error_length_check
crawl_pages_error_length_check.value: ("crawl_pages"."error_type" is null or length("crawl_pages"."error_type") between 1 and 120) and ("crawl_pages"."error_message" is null or length("crawl_pages"."error_message") between 1 and 2000)

crawl_robots_origin_length_check.name: crawl_robots_origin_length_check
crawl_robots_origin_length_check.value: length("crawl_robots"."origin") between 8 and 4096 and length("crawl_robots"."hostname") between 1 and 253

crawl_usage_reservations_release_check.name: crawl_usage_reservations_release_check

crawls_error_length_check.name: crawls_error_length_check
crawls_error_length_check.value: ("crawls"."error_type" is null or length("crawls"."error_type") between 1 and 120) and ("crawls"."error_message" is null or length("crawls"."error_message") between 1 and 2000) and ("crawls"."completion_reason" is null or length("crawls"."completion_reason") between 1 and 2000)

crawls_counters_check.name: crawls_counters_check
crawls_counters_check.value: "crawls"."attempt_count" >= 0 and "crawls"."discovered_count" >= 0 and "crawls"."processed_count" >= 0 and "crawls"."succeeded_count" >= 0 and "crawls"."failed_count" >= 0 and "crawls"."blocked_count" >= 0 and "crawls"."skipped_count" >= 0 and "crawls"."bytes_received" >= 0 and "crawls"."processed_count" = "crawls"."succeeded_count" + "crawls"."failed_count" + "crawls"."blocked_count" + "crawls"."skipped_count" and "crawls"."processed_count" <= "crawls"."discovered_count"

crawls_finished_at_check.name: crawls_finished_at_check
crawls_finished_at_check.value: ("crawls"."status" in ('cancelled', 'failed', 'partially_completed', 'completed') and "crawls"."finished_at" is not null) or ("crawls"."status" not in ('cancelled', 'failed', 'partially_completed', 'completed') and "crawls"."finished_at" is null)

crawls_execution_lease_check.name: crawls_execution_lease_check
crawls_execution_lease_check.value: ("crawls"."status" in ('validating', 'discovering', 'crawling') and "crawls"."execution_token" is not null and "crawls"."execution_lease_expires_at" is not null) or ("crawls"."status" not in ('validating', 'discovering', 'crawling') and "crawls"."execution_token" is null and "crawls"."execution_lease_expires_at" is null)

invitations_client_project_check.name: invitations_client_project_check
invitations_client_project_check.value: ("invitations"."role" = 'client' and "invitations"."project_id" is not null) or ("invitations"."role" <> 'client' and "invitations"."project_id" is null)

invitations_lifecycle_check.name: invitations_lifecycle_check
invitations_lifecycle_check.value: ("invitations"."status" = 'accepted' and "invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "invitations"."accepted_by_user_id" is not null and "invitations"."revoked_at" is null) or ("invitations"."status" = 'revoked' and "invitations"."revoked_at" is not null and "invitations"."accepted_at" is null) or ("invitations"."status" in ('pending', 'expired') and "invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "invitations"."accepted_by_user_id" is null and "invitations"."revoked_at" is null)

job_outbox_lease_check.name: job_outbox_lease_check
job_outbox_lease_check.value: ("job_outbox"."status" = 'publishing' and "job_outbox"."claim_token" is not null and "job_outbox"."locked_at" is not null and "job_outbox"."lease_expires_at" is not null) or ("job_outbox"."status" <> 'publishing' and "job_outbox"."claim_token" is null and "job_outbox"."locked_at" is null and "job_outbox"."lease_expires_at" is null)

job_outbox_published_at_check.name: job_outbox_published_at_check
job_outbox_published_at_check.value: ("job_outbox"."status" = 'published' and "job_outbox"."published_at" is not null) or ("job_outbox"."status" <> 'published' and "job_outbox"."published_at" is null)

job_outbox_error_length_check.name: job_outbox_error_length_check
job_outbox_error_length_check.value: "job_outbox"."last_error" is null or length("job_outbox"."last_error") between 1 and 2000

project_verifications_verified_at_check.name: project_verifications_verified_at_check
project_verifications_verified_at_check.value: ("project_verifications"."status" = 'verified' and "project_verifications"."verified_at" is not null) or ("project_verifications"."status" <> 'verified' and "project_verifications"."verified_at" is null)
